PHYSICS — TERMLY EXAM #19
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Glucose and oxygen

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Physics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Physics.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Physics.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Physics.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Physics.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Pressure? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Pressure.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Pressure.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Pressure.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Pressure.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res.

6. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   B. Removing all vegetation
   C. Overgrazing continuously
   D. Burning crop residue every week

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mechanical Properties of Materials? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mechanical Properties of Materials.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Mechanical Properties of Materials.

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. Any white crystal used in cooking
   D. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy, Work, Power and Machines? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy, Work, Power and Machines.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy, Work, Power and Machines.

11. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

12. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Iron rusting
   B. Ice melting to water
   C. Milk souring
   D. Paper burning to ash

13. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Introduction to Electronics? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Introduction to Electronics.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Introduction to Electronics.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Introduction to Electronics.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Introduction to Electronics.

14. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Movement of water only across a membrane
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

15. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. watt (W)
   B. newton (N)
   C. joule (J)
   D. pascal (Pa)

16. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Radioactivity and Stability of Isotopes and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Current Electricity Measurement of current, e.m.f., potential difference and res and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Electronics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change 4.2 Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 o and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Greenhouse Effect and Climate Change and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Introduction to Space Physics Page 15 of 62 1 STRAND 1.0 MECHANICS AND THERMAL P and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
